Translate Like Me - Menu bar translator that replaces the selected text in any app, in your own writing style, via Claude, ChatGPT or Grok.

summary.one_liner: Translate Like Me is an open-source macOS menu bar app that dictates, rewrites, and translates selected text in any app, keeping your personal writing style.
use_cases: Translate a selected message in place into another language
Rewrite rough notes into a clear message in your own style
Draft a reply to a received message from your notes
Dictate text at the cursor with local speech recognition
Translate offline using a local MLX model
Polish a draft before sending it in another language
how_to_run: Or download the latest release, unzip it, and move Translate Like Me.app to /Applications
Build from source: git clone the repository, then cd translate-like-me
notable: Global shortcuts: hold Right Option to dictate at the cursor; select text and press a shortcut to rewrite or translate it in place
Writing style presets guide rewrites and translations so output sounds like you
Local-first option: dictation and local translation run on the Mac, with no account or API key needed for dictation
Cloud engines are optional and go through official CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Antigravity) using your existing sign-in
Protected clipboard is restored after insertion, and Copy Last Result keeps recent output until quit
caveats: Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon
Cloud engines need their official CLI installed and signed in, and are subject to provider plan limits and terms
Lighter local model has more limitations in translation and Rewrite
Source build requires Xcode 26 or later and Swift 6.3 or later
